name: setup-manaflow-ai-plush-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces, in soft raised shapes: theme files for color, the terminal palette and proportions (Plush, light, the default; Plush Dark; and two more tints, Dusk and Clay, each in light and dark), settings for the chat's sans at a reading size, a stylesheet that raises your prompt box and messages out of the page with a pair of soft shadows and presses inline code into it, and a Markdown stylesheet with round, borderless code. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
